footer.blurb: A marketing company for local and multi-location businesses. Websites, search and advertising, run as one system and tracked to the dollar, by people you can call.

ad_landing.founders.heading: Two partners. No account managers in between.
ad_landing.founders.sub: There's no sales team, and no hand-off to a junior after you sign. There are two of us, we own the business equally, and we're the two who do the work. Either of us answers the phone.

ad_landing.plan.name: your marketing audit
ad_landing.plan.headline: It tells you where the money's going. Then where it should go.
ad_landing.plan.sub: We go through your account without changing a thing in it, and write up what we find with the money attached to every line. Ranked, specific, and built against your real accounts rather than a template. Then we quote the work, or tell you plainly that you don't need us yet.
ad_landing.plan.refrain: Start with the audit. Decide after.
ad_landing.plan.effort: A few fields. A partner reads it, not an autoresponder.
